title: NHCE - Problem Solving Using Python Lab
description: Tactical Course for New Horizon College of Engineering (25CSL144)

syllabus.textbook: Allen B. Downey, Think Python, 3rd Edition, O'Reilly, 2024

outcomes.CO1: Apply Python fundamentals to solve computational and mathematical problems.
outcomes.CO2: Demonstrate the use of iterative control structures, conditional statements, and string manipulation for problem-solving.
outcomes.CO3: Implement operations on Python data structures and perform basic file-handling techniques for data management.
outcomes.CO4: Apply user-defined functions, classes, and exception handling to design structured and efficient Python programs for real-world problem solving.

units.title: Problem Solving Using Python Lab
units.syllabus: Prerequisite programs, Part A conventional programs (1-6), Part B open-ended programs (7-12), Part C beyond-syllabus virtual lab content.

topics.title: Basics of Programming
topics.note: Backed by Unit 1.1 and 1.2 of 25CSE144 (algorithms, flowcharts, first program). Needs a lab-shaped walkthrough of the editor, running a script and reading an error.

topics.title: Program 1: Area of a Circle and a Triangle
topics.note: Backed by Unit 1.3 (arithmetic operators, type conversion) and 1.4 (input/output).

topics.title: Program 2: Compute n + nn + nnn, and Product-or-Sum of Two Integers
topics.note: Backed by Unit 1.3 (numeric expressions, type conversion) and Unit 2.1 (if-else).

topics.title: Program 3: Multiplication Table and Counting Even and Odd Numbers
topics.note: Backed by Unit 2.2 (for loops, range, common loop patterns).

topics.title: Program 4: Sort a Hyphen-Separated Sequence of Words
topics.note: Backed by Unit 3.2 (splitting and joining) and Unit 4.1 (list built-in functions and sorting).

topics.title: Program 5: Count Uppercase, Lowercase and Spaces, and Toggle Case
topics.note: Backed by Unit 3.1 (indexing, slicing) and Unit 3.2 (Python string functions).

topics.title: Program 6: Add a Key to a Dictionary
topics.note: Backed by Unit 4.4 (accessing, adding, updating and removing values).

topics.title: Program 7: Remove an Item from a Set and Find Repeated Items in a Tuple
topics.note: Backed by Unit 4.2 (tuple operations) and Unit 4.3 (set operations and built-in methods).

topics.title: Program 8: Count Lines in a Text File, Append Text and Display It
topics.note: Backed by Unit 5.1 (reading text files, writing and appending, the with statement).

topics.title: Program 9: Generate 26 Text Files Named A.txt to Z.txt
topics.note: Backed by Unit 5.1 (writing files) and Unit 2.2 (for loops). Needs the chr/ord idiom, which no catalogue page teaches.

topics.title: Program 10: DivExp with an Assertion and a Divide-by-Zero Exception
topics.note: Backed by Unit 3.3 (assertion usage, try/except, raising exceptions) and Unit 2.3 (functions).

topics.title: Program 11: A Complex Class that Adds N Complex Numbers
topics.note: Backed by Unit 5.3 (creating classes, the __init__ constructor) and Unit 5.4 (operator overloading via __add__).

topics.title: Program 12: Student Grade Tracker
topics.note: Backed by Unit 4.1, 4.2 and 4.4 (lists of tuples and dictionaries) and Unit 2.3 (functions).

chapters.title: Part C - Beyond Syllabus Virtual Lab

topics.title: Virtual Lab Walkthrough: IIIT-H Python Labs and LabEx
topics.note: Not assessed in CIE or SEE. Needs a short orientation page pointing at python-iiith.vlabs.ac.in and labex.io/free-labs/python.
